params.body:
Phase 1, step 6b of `docs/design/sources-before-more-sources.md`. Needs
Trendwolves/gentells-pipeline#186 for the `/collection` route; without it the
section shows one quiet line and the rest of the page is untouched.

The Sources page lists what *should* be collected. Above it now stands what *is*:
per adapter the road it takes (api, feed, scraper), when it last delivered, what
it said it would deliver, what its last run was, and what the last thirty days
brought and cost. Below the table: the rows that are switched on while nothing
collects them, and the adapters that are switched off with the reason for each.

This table exists because of one line, `tiktok-trends: 0 signals, 0 errors`,
logged every round from 12 May. It meant the actor returned nothing and it read
as a quiet day. Nothing anywhere said when a source last spoke.

## It states facts and does not judge

No row is coloured late or on time. How long is too long is decided in one
place, Elixir, and a second opinion on this screen would be a second truth. The
one colour belongs to the run itself: a run that failed says so, in `hot`, which
the brand guide already reserves for broken sources.

Rows are ordered oldest word first, never heard from before that, because the
rows worth reading are the ones that would otherwise sit at the bottom.

Follows `BRAND.md`: table header uppercase `txt-3` on a 2px `border-bright`
rule, rows on 1px `border`, numbers mono and right aligned, no decoration.

Looked at once with the live payload from the box before proposing; that look
caught "today" on a signal from the evening before, now "under a day ago".

Not in this PR, on purpose: switching an adapter on or off from the screen. That
needs the collector to read a switch instead of a list in code, which is its own
change and belongs with phase 2.
params.title: Sources: where the collector's adapters stand
